name: tunelet
description: Vocal pitch correction, choir, harmony, formant control and effects for WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release --no-pack --features wasm --locked && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('pkg/.gitignore', { force: true })"
